description: This file is a shell script designed to test error handling and reference operations in a Git repository. It contains test functions and test cases that verify behavior of 'git update-ref' commands under various scenarios involving references creation, deletion, conflicts, symbolic references, and error conditions.

methods.name: test_update_rejected
methods.description: Tests rejection cases for 'git update-ref' when attempting to create references that conflict with existing references.

methods.name: df_test
methods.description: Tests adding and deleting conflicting references (D/F conflicts) in various configurations, including symbolic references and packing references.
